comparisonMethod.commands: Exact command JSON structure including action_ref and complete data; cross-checked against every campaign action. No substitution or command normalization.
comparisonMethod.pixelAndAnimationPolicy: Every pixel value, row width, image height, animation length and frame ordering is compared exactly. No raster, animation, score or state normalization.
comparisonMethod.objectKeyOrder: Only JSON object member order is immaterial. Arrays and scalar representations are retained. Equality is checked on complete canonical JSON values, not just hashes.
comparisonMethod.publicActionDomain: Every saved available_action_refs array matches exactly, including order. No action-domain extension or projection is required.
comparisonMethod.campaignPacketHashes: The native report JSON.stringify-style insertion-order packet hashes are separately reconstructed from the saved native trace and checked at every saved checkpoint.
comparisonMethod.boundaries: Exact official completed-level/action projections, independently rederived from consecutive public score packets.
comparisonMethod.prefixes: Exact executed action counts for every sealed prefix and the labeled-sequence proposal kind. Full proposal metadata and retained caller states are outside this comparison.
comparisonMethod.terminationDifference: The original isolated component targeted six levels and abstained at the initial sixth-level query after five completed levels. The native campaign targeted five levels and stopped immediately after reaching that target. All 40 source actions and all 41 source packets are compared; no source action or public packet suffix is omitted.

qualification.referenceScope: Unchanged isolated original labeled-sequence component; not original full common caller selection.
qualification.nativeScope: Fresh native common caller with original labeled-sequence transfer and explicitly recorded native coordination extensions.
qualification.reason: The reference run exercises the isolated original labeled-sequence component. Matching its public trajectory does not compare full original cross-family caller selection or its retained state.
